observations.observation: At 2026-10-07 11:12 UTC, Research and Markets issued a release announcing a report listing and stating market estimates and sector drivers. The Micron mention is an example within that general market discussion, not a company-status disclosure.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The market-size figures and Micron facility reference are claims in a Research and Markets press release; the release supplies no methodology or Micron-specific operational update.

observations.observation: A MarketResearch.com catalog listing dated April 11, 2026 carries the same report title and the same market value and forecast figures, so the October release appears to be a later offering/dissemination notice rather than the first public appearance of those estimates.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This is a catalog listing for a report, not independent validation of its estimates; matching title and publisher do not confirm the exact ResearchAndMarkets catalog record.

observations.observation: Micron’s pre-cutoff Form 10-Q describes two Idaho fab plans and their projected timing, providing prior project context for the release’s Idaho reference.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The filing does not quantify a $35 billion cost for one Idaho facility, and its output dates are projections rather than completed milestones.

gaps: No independent contemporaneous editorial coverage with a verified pre-cutoff timestamp was established. A Yahoo Finance copy surfaced in search, but its exact publication time was not verified.
The underlying full report and its methodology were not independently reviewed.
No pre-cutoff archived snapshot of the ResearchAndMarkets product page was verified, so its current report-date metadata was not used as evidence that the listing existed in that form by the cutoff.
The reviewed Micron filing does not reconcile the release’s $35 billion Idaho-facility description with the company’s project-specific investment figures.
research_notes: The earliest traceable source for the October 7 dissemination is Research and Markets’ GlobeNewswire release, timestamped 07:12 ET (11:12 UTC), about six minutes before the cutoff. It announces that a report was added to the offering; it is not a Micron issuer update. An earlier catalog listing for a report with the same title and forecast provides prior context, but is not independent validation. Search surfaced a Yahoo Finance copy, but its exact publication time could not be verified and it was not treated as eligible independent, pre-cutoff coverage. A current ResearchAndMarkets listing labels the report April 2026, but no pre-cutoff snapshot was verified, so that page is not used as cutoff evidence.
